content.text: how many tokens I've spent on yyot till this date? use ccusage to estimate the API cost as well

**About 2.33 billion tokens on yyot, with an estimated API-equivalent cost of roughly $1,750**, through **October 11, 2026**.

| Records | Tokens | Estimated cost |
|---|---:|---:|
| Available logs, calculated by ccusage | 2.194 billion | $1,643.25 |
| 54 older chats with missing logs | 138 million | ~$103 extrapolated |
| **Combined estimate** | **2.332 billion** | **~$1,747** |

Used **ccusage 20.0.29**, including yyot’s worktrees and subagents. About **97%** of the available-log tokens were cached input.

The missing-log cost assumes the same average rate. These are approximate API equivalents, not actual subscription charges. [ccusage methodology](https://ccusage.com/guide/codex/)

[Saved detailed report](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/11/01a12a8c-dd9d-79e3-bde7-01ff31c845ae/yyot-token-usage-2026-10-11.md)
can we get to know what models did I used here and its TPS as well?

**You used four models.** Exact generation TPS isn’t recorded, but I calculated **effective output tokens per second** from completed turns.

Using the same October 11 snapshot:

| Model | Tokens in available logs | API-equivalent cost | Effective output tok/s |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **GPT-6.1 Sol** | 1.646 billion | $580.47 | **25.8** |
| **GPT-6 Astra** | 517.36 million | $1,062.09 | **21.6** |
| **GPT-6 Luna** | 30.74 million | $0.70 | **31.1** |
| **GPT-6 Sol** | 2.55 million in older counters | Unavailable | Unavailable |

**These speeds include tool execution, waits, and reasoning**, so they measure your workflow’s throughput rather than pure model generation speed. Samples: **793 Sol turns, 192 Astra turns, and only 2 Luna turns**.

Older missing logs also contain additional Sol and Astra usage, excluded from the priced rows above.

[Detailed model and timing report](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/11/01a12a8c-dd9d-79e3-bde7-01ff31c845ae/yyot-models-and-throughput-2026-10-11.md)
could you tell cumulatively how much time did I spent here?

Verified saved report:

| Measure | Duration |
|---|---:|
| All completed turns, added together | **86h 00m 46s** |
| All runs, overlapping time counted once | **44h 35m 45s** |
| Top-level chats, overlapping time counted once | **43h 11m 11s** |
| Subagent turns, added together | **30h 14m 46s** |

Coverage: **987 turns across 203 chats**, from **October 3–11 IST**. Sources: 101 user chats, 3 voice chats, 2 agent-created chats, 97 subagent chats.

Recommend describing **44h 36m as recorded elapsed AI activity**, with **86 hours of cumulative agent runtime**. Neither measures the user’s actual attention or time spent typing/reading. The saved throughput dataset omits 114 records without completed durations and 140 without output usage; raw task events may expand coverage.
